description:
linked https://github.com/unoplatform/uno-private/issues/1484

## ✨ Feature
Add ability to forward commands from VSIX

## What is the current behavior? 🤔
Commands request are only emitted by the RC.VS package

## What is the new behavior? 🚀
Commands can be received from the VSIX and forwarded to the dev-server

comments.body:
The `CancellationTokenSource` should be readonly to prevent accidental reassignment and ensure thread-safe disposal.
```suggestion
	private readonly CancellationTokenSource _ct = new();
```

This TODO comment indicates a known technical debt. Consider creating a tracking issue to refactor this to use proper scoped dependency injection rather than manual instantiation and disposal registration.

As i assume we are planning to use the name of the DevelopmentEnvironmentComponent on front-end. I am thinking that dev-server is not a user-friendly name here since users don't quite know what dev-server is. Maybe for a front-end part we should call it Hot-Reload?
